name: JoAi: Delete Hook

description.en: Remove a registered hook (automation) by its id.
description.de: Entferne einen registrierten Hook (Automatisierung) anhand seiner ID.
description.es: Elimina un hook (automatización) registrado por su id.
description.fr: Supprimez un hook (automatisation) enregistré par son id.
description.ro: Șterge un hook (automatizare) înregistrat după id-ul său.
description.it: Rimuovi un hook (automazione) registrato tramite il suo id.

bot: Removes a registered hook so it stops firing. The hook id is required — use list_hooks to find it if the user doesn't provide one.

description.en: The id of the hook to remove
description.de: Die ID des zu entfernenden Hooks
description.es: El id del hook a eliminar
